description: Change the files of one of your skills. The changes are saved as a pending version, the current version stays as it is, and the skill is switched off with status needs-review until the user accepts the update in Besidka. A pending update that was already waiting is replaced. SKILL.md cannot be deleted or renamed, LICENSE and NOTICE files are protected, and changing the name is refused: use rename_skill. The skill is saved disabled. The user must review and enable it in Besidka at the reviewUrl in the result, which also lists the findings of the scan and a summary of the changed files. At most 30 skill changes an hour. Requires signing in (skills:write).

baseVersion.description: The current version number you read; a skill that changed since is refused

changes.description: Put (add or replace a file), delete or rename a file, in order, at most 50, at most 400 KiB of file content in all

name: update_skill
title: Update a skill
